islands.name: Material Island
islands.desc: This is the place for 24/7 Evolution materials! You can get Lv. 15-30 B-C Class monsters.

islands.name: Spirit Island
islands.desc: This is the place for 24/7 Evolution materials! You can get Lv. 15-30 A Class monsters.

islands.name: Magic Island
islands.desc: This is the place for 24/7 Evolution materials! You can get Lv. 15~30 and S Class monsters

islands.name: Training Island
islands.desc:
Training is the key to strength!
This is your chance to gain a lot of EXP.
Open on Monday and Wednesday!
islands._source: Bosses (Spooki line 3-6 stars), Hard lineup Treant/Roonga/Jelliton and 4 stages: 3lUuIs6OFEo 2:28-3:30; other tiers follow the same evolution lines.

islands.name: Treasure Island
islands.desc:
Come over here if you need some money!
You can get loads of gold here!
Open Sundays.
islands._source: Bosses Prisbal/Mewceleste/Pentacorn, energy 7/10/15, yellow monster cubes, 3 waves on Easy: D9HuvYhKiJQ.

islands.name: Friendship Island
islands.desc:
Uses Friend Points instead of Energy.
Send Friend Points to your friends and bring them here!
islands._source: Drop lists and Friend Point use: Monster Squad Wiki Special Islands. FP costs, levels and bosses are estimates.

islands.name: Jungle Island
islands.desc:
What kind of monsters are waiting in the jungle?
This is your chance to get a Nature monster!
islands._source: Quest names and energy 3/5/8/10: zj5T4GOAim4 (Volcano names/energy assumed to match). Jungle opens Thursday; Normal/Hard bosses from footage. Extreme boss Whylie (wiki drop list; footage shows its evolution Whynoceros).

islands.name: Icicle Island
islands.desc:
A troop of fierce monsters is coming from the frozen regions!
This is your chance to get a Water monster!
islands._source: Quest names and energy 3/5/8/10: zj5T4GOAim4 (Volcano names/energy assumed to match). Icicle Easy/Normal/Hard bosses and Easy drop list from footage; Extreme boss estimate.

islands.name: Hunter's Folly
islands.desc: When Demon Hunters fall prey to those they're hunting, they become a deadly threat. Can you guide hunters to the right path?
islands.promo: [FREE on Friday] You can get ★4 Lowe by exploring this island.

islands.name: K9 Kingdom
islands.desc: This holy garden was once a paradise for dogs, but now it's being occupied by selfish monsters. Help Arch Bern restore peace to this land.
islands.promo: Help Arch Bern restore peace to Doggy Heaven!
